why: Checkpoint policy for long-living orchestrating sessions (phase 0). Provisional: a research task is producing measured values; every number below is a starting point, not a finding.

warn_pct.why: Tell the session early that a checkpoint is coming, so it can reach a clean turn boundary instead of being cut mid-task.

checkpoint_pct.why: Checkpoint while there is still room to write a good handoff; quality of long-context recall degrades well before the window is full.

force_pct.why: Past this the client's own auto-compaction (lossy, uncontrolled) is close; force the handoff before it fires.

ceiling_200k_class.why: Windows up to ~250k tokens are the 200k class; checkpoint at 140k absolute (70%) regardless of the reported percentage.

ceiling_1m_class.why: 1M-class windows: quality, not capacity, is the limit; reasoning over 300k+ tokens of history degrades, so checkpoint at 300k even though the window could hold more.

velocity_turns.why: Checkpoint now if the last turn's growth, repeated this many times, would cross force_pct: one big tool result can jump past the thresholds between two checks.

idle_boundary_only.why: Only checkpoint at an idle turn boundary (no tool call in flight), so no result is lost between the old and the new session.

self_handoff_deadline_s.why: The session writing its own handoff gets 5 minutes; after that the deterministic builder's handoff is used instead so a stuck session cannot block the restart.

handoff_total_tokens.why: The handoff must be small next to the fresh window (5% of 200k) so the restarted session starts with room to work.

section_budgets.why: Per-section token budgets: excerpts get the most because they carry the working detail; files are a short list; the sum equals handoff_total_tokens.

goal_prompts.why: The last 3 user prompts, verbatim, state the current goal better than any summary.

recency_pin_messages.why: The last 8 messages are where in-flight identifiers live and get a recency bonus in the excerpt ranking: the newest turns matter most after a restart.

recency_bonus.why: Score bonus for excerpts inside the recency pin: larger than one shared goal word (+3) so recent context wins ties, smaller than two.

tool_result_truncation_chars.why: Tool results in excerpts are shown truncated: their head identifies the result; the full text can be re-read with the tool.

excerpt_message_truncation_chars.why: Long messages are cut so one wall of text cannot take the whole excerpt budget.

circuit_breaker.why: 3 restarts within 20 minutes means the handoff itself is too big or the task loops; pause 30 minutes and tell the owner instead of restarting forever.
